lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Si4Sb4 (reduced formula Mg3(SiSb)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 14), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies 12-coordinate Mg environments (5 Sb, 7 Si) and 8-coordinate Sb and Si environments (each with 4 Mg and 4 of the other metal). These polyhedra show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts among Mg and Sb polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
